say:1:1110801001:0.text: Alrighty, let's get down to business.

say:2:1110801002:0.text: After being away for so long, there must be a lot for us to deal with!
say:2:1110801002:0.source_cn: 离开了这么久，族里一定有很多事需要我们处理！

say:4:1110801003:0.source_cn: 阿尔萨姐姐！你们终于回来了！

say:6:1110801005:0.text: Oh no, a girl as adorable as you shouldn't be shedding tears. Let me guess, did Simba try to bully you?
say:6:1110801005:0.source_cn: 哈，我们可爱的哈佩怎么了？别哭别哭，让我猜猜，是小瑟巴...

say:8:1110801006:0.text: No... he didn't... I'm scared because everyone went on a <style="highlight">treasure hunt</style>, but it's been a long time, and they still haven't returned.

choice_prompt:9:1110801006.text: No... he didn't... I'm scared because everyone went on a <style="highlight">treasure hunt</style>, but it's been a long time, and they still haven't returned.
choice_prompt:9:1110801006.source_cn: 不……没……大家吵着要去<style=highlight>寻宝</style>，但到现在一点消息都没有，哈佩很害怕……

say:10:1110801007:1.text: When Alsa and Soren left for the Warsong Festival, a group of merchants stopped nearby. They had many large bags and tall horses...
say:10:1110801007:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨姐姐和索恩哥哥出发参加战歌节之后，有一群路过卖东...

say:11:1110801008:1.text: They said, "Towards the sunrise, <style="highlight">treasures are hidden in the Eroded Enclave</style>."
say:11:1110801008:1.source_cn: 他们说，往太阳升起的方向，那边的<style=high...

say:12:1110801009:1.text: Then, Simba and some of the big kids decided to go find the treasure with those people!
say:12:1110801009:1.source_cn: 听到宝藏的消息，瑟巴，还有其他一些哥哥姐姐，决定要跟那...

say:14:1110801010:1.text: And they haven't sent any messages back yet?
say:14:1110801010:1.source_cn: ……但他们到现在也没传回消息？

say:15:1110801011:0.text: No... I waited for a long, long time until all of you returned, but there was still no word from them. I'm so worried...
say:15:1110801011:0.source_cn: 没有……我在族里等了很久很久，直到你们都回来了，他们还...

say:16:1110801012:0.text: Don't worry, we're here for you. Soren and I will definitely bring them back.
say:16:1110801012:0.source_cn: 别怕，有我们在。我和索恩一定会把他们带回来的。

say:20:1110801013:0.text: *Sigh* Those young ones are so silly...

choice_prompt:21:1110801013.text: *Sigh* Those young ones are so silly...

say:22:1110801014:1.text: I'm older than them! As their elder sister, I have the responsibility to take good care of them!
say:22:1110801014:1.source_cn: 我比他们大！作为大家的姐姐，当然应该承担起照顾他们的责任！

say:23:1110801015:1.text: Soren, pack up! Let's head out and find them!
say:23:1110801015:1.source_cn: 不能再耽误了。索恩，收拾一下，我们马上就出发！

say:24:1110801016:0.text: Okay, just calm down and think things through.

say:25:1110801017:1.text: The Uru Clan needs a leader in charge while we're gone.
say:25:1110801017:1.source_cn: 我们离开这么久，现在乌尔氏族需要有人统领。

say:26:1110801018:1.text: You stay. I'll go look for them.

say:27:1110801019:1.source_cn: 索恩……你……你终于成熟起来了！

say:28:1110801020:1.text: You're clumsy, you going there would only slow things down.
say:28:1110801020:1.source_cn: 你冒冒失失的，去了也会拖后腿。

say:29:1110801021:1.text: Hey! I take what I said back!

choice_prompt:30:1110801021.text: Hey! I take what I said back!

say:33:1110801022:1.text: Exactly! That Hypogean posing as Merlin could very well still be lurking nearby, scheming away!
say:33:1110801022:1.source_cn: 对！那个假扮梅林的恶魔，说不定还藏在附近，筹划着阴谋。
say:33:1110801022:1.male: Exactly! That Hypogean posing as Merlin could very well still be lurking nearby, scheming away!
say:33:1110801022:1.female: Exactly! That Hypogean posing as Merlin could very well still be lurking nearby, scheming away!

say:36:1110801023:1.text: Hammie is right! If what Soren is looking into is connected to that Hypogean's bad intentions, it could spell trouble!
say:36:1110801023:1.source_cn: 就是就是，万一索恩要调查的事情和那家伙的坏主意有关，就糟了！

say:37:1110801024:1.text: And word about the treasure happens to come from the Eroded Enclave...
say:37:1110801024:1.source_cn: 宝藏传言，还恰巧是从风蚀飞地传出……

choice_prompt:38:1110801024.text: And word about the treasure happens to come from the Eroded Enclave...
choice_prompt:38:1110801024.source_cn: 宝藏传言，还恰巧是从风蚀飞地传出……

say:39:1110801025:1.text: It's the worst place of all.

say:40:1110801026:1.text: Those ruthless fortune seekers cast aside their pride and honor.
say:40:1110801026:1.source_cn: 那里的人都是追逐利益的狂徒，把自尊和荣誉抛于脑后。

say:41:1110801027:1.text: While Maulers also inhabit the area, it's more like a melting pot of different tribes, unlike the Ashen Wastes where the bond through bloodlines is exceptionally strong.
say:41:1110801027:1.source_cn: 虽然也有蛮血在活动，但各个部族杂居，并非荒角沙漠这样以...

say:42:1110801028:1.text: That place is a hotbed of danger and chaos. I wonder what treasure could be hidden in a place like that?
say:42:1110801028:1.source_cn: 既混乱，又危险。\n我倒是很好奇，究竟什么宝藏会埋藏在...

say:43:1110801029:1.text: She mentioned large bags and tall horses... Sounds like they went to the Eroded Enclave with some <style="highlight">foreign caravans</style>.
say:43:1110801029:1.source_cn: 卖东西的人、马儿和货物……听起来像是商队。你们的族人应...

say:44:1110801030:1.text: We will find Simba and the others if we find the caravans!
say:44:1110801030:1.source_cn: 那么，只要找到商队，就能找到小瑟巴他们了！

say:47:1110801031:1.text: Alright, the clock is ticking! Soren, please bring our family back to where they belong!
say:47:1110801031:1.source_cn: 那就这么定了！时间不等人。索恩，一定要把我们的家人带回来！

choice:30:0:1.text: We have matters to investigate too.
choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 我们正好也有想调查的事情
choice:30:0:1.male: We have matters to investigate too.
choice:30:0:1.female: We have matters to investigate too.

choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 假梅林——贝利尔还下落不明

say:0:1110802001:0.text: The Eroded Enclave is this way.

say:1:1110802002:0.text: Keep an eye on the ground. They might've left some tracks behind for us to follow.
say:1:1110802002:0.source_cn: 留意脚下，他们可能会留下痕迹。

say:0:1110803001:0.text: These hoofprints and wheel tracks seem to be very recent.
say:0:1110803001:0.source_cn: 这是马蹄和车辙。看起来很新。

say:1:1110803002:0.text: Let's follow these tracks so we can find them!
say:1:1110803002:0.source_cn: 是去寻宝的商队！跟着车辙走，就能找到他们！

say:2:1110804001:1.text: Excuse me! Have you seen a group of Mauler kids from the Ashen Wastes?
say:2:1110804001:1.source_cn: 您好！请问，你有见过一群从荒角沙漠来的蛮血孩子吗？

say:3:1110804002:1.text: Hey, look! We have a hamster visitor!

say:4:1110804003:0.text: I am no regular hamster! I am a familiar!
say:4:1110804003:0.source_cn: 不是普通的仓鼠！是使魔！

say:5:1110804004:1.text: Oops, apologies for my rudeness. I've seen many Mauler kids... Can you be more specific?
say:5:1110804004:1.source_cn: 抱歉抱歉，是我怠慢了。\n路经荒角沙漠，蛮血孩子我见过...

say:8:1110804005:0.text: They are from the Uru Clan, just like me.

say:9:1110804006:0.text: They tagged along with incoming caravans in pursuit of treasure and haven't returned since.
say:9:1110804006:0.source_cn: 他们跟着外来商队来寻宝，至今未归。

say:10:1110804007:0.text: Oh, young man, guess what? We are just the ones you're looking for!
say:10:1110804007:0.source_cn: 哎呀，小兄弟，你说的外来商队，恰好就是我们！

say:11:1110804008:0.text: We stopped by the Uru Clan, and your kin offered us water from the oasis. That was very kind of them.
say:11:1110804008:0.source_cn: 我们商队曾经在乌尔氏族停留过，你们的部族成员挺友善，主...

say:12:1110804009:1.text: In return for their kindness, we told them about the treasure. They seemed extremely interested and insisted on tagging along.
say:12:1110804009:1.source_cn: 作为回报，我们把宝藏的消息告诉他们了，你们部族有人很感...

say:13:1110804010:0.text: It's been great teaming up with them; we handle the trading, and they're off on their treasure hunts. It's a win-win, and having extra folks around makes the journey more enjoyable!
say:13:1110804010:0.source_cn: 我们卖货，他们寻宝，互不耽误，路上还能互相做个照应，多好！

say:14:1110804011:0.text: Where are the others? Why are you the only one here?

say:15:1110804012:1.text: Well, my carriage broke down. The big group had to leave first. With big deals waiting, time is money!
say:15:1110804012:1.source_cn: 咳，我这马车坏了，实在没办法。大部队提前先走了，大宗买...

say:16:1110804013:1.text: The caravans are heading to Alkali to unload the goods and kickstart our trade. If you're looking for your kin, Alkali is the place to be!

choice_prompt:17:1110804013.text: The caravans are heading to Alkali to unload the goods and kickstart our trade. If you're looking for your kin, Alkali is the place to be!
choice_prompt:17:1110804013.source_cn: 我们准备去<style=highlight>咸水镇</style>卸货，然后正式开始营商。你要找族人，去咸水镇准没错！

say:18:1110804014:0.text: Follow this path, and you'll see a checkpoint ahead. Then it's a good half-day journey east.
say:18:1110804014:0.source_cn: 喏，沿着这条路走，路过一个隘口关卡，要往东走大半天才能到。

say:19:1110804015:0.text: Keep your guard up! This weather can conjure up a sandstorm out of nowhere!
say:19:1110804015:0.source_cn: 路上小心，这鬼天气，不知道什么就会起沙暴！

say:0:1110805001:0.text: These tracks lead toward Alkali too.
say:0:1110805001:0.source_cn: 咸水镇，正是车辙的方向。

say:2:1110806001:0.text: Look! The Maulers here have blocked the road with a barricade, so no one can get through!
say:2:1110806001:0.source_cn: 你们看！这里的蛮血用拒马把路拦住了，这样就过不去了！

say:3:1110806002:0.text: Why would they block the one and only road?
say:3:1110806002:0.source_cn: 好端端的，为什么要把唯一的道路封住呢？

say:6:1110806003:0.text: Halt! State your business! Are you here for trade or treasure hunting?
say:6:1110806003:0.source_cn: 留步！你们来做什么？寻宝？还是经商？

say:10:1110806004:0.text: We're here to find my little siblings.

say:11:1110806005:0.text: Have your folks gone missing as well?
say:11:1110806005:0.source_cn: 找人？你们的族人也失踪了？

choice_prompt:12:1110806005.text: Have your folks gone missing as well?
choice_prompt:12:1110806005.source_cn: 找人？你们的族人也失踪了？

say:13:1110806006:0.text: Lots of folks have disappeared recently, locals and treasure hunters alike...
say:13:1110806006:0.source_cn: 最近有很多人突然不见踪影，当地的蛮血、外来寻宝的狂热者……

say:14:1110806007:0.text: Must be those blasted <style="highlight">Quicksand Claws</style>, I tell ya, those lowlifes got no honor! So, I've blocked the road to prevent any more abductions!

choice_prompt:15:1110806007.text: Must be those blasted <style="highlight">Quicksand Claws</style>, I tell ya, those lowlifes got no honor! So, I've blocked the road to prevent any more abductions!
choice_prompt:15:1110806007.source_cn: 俺们知道，肯定都是<style=highlight>流沙之爪</style>干的，那群为非作歹的渣滓，抛弃荣耀的走兽！所以俺才要把路封上，免得他们又来掳人！

say:2:1110808001:0.text: Oh, wow! You kids really know how to fight!
say:2:1110808001:0.source_cn: 哦哦！你们几个娃子，战斗本领真不错！

say:3:1110808002:0.text: Those thugs didn't stand a chance against you!
say:3:1110808002:0.source_cn: 那群流沙之爪对你们完全造不成威胁！

choice_prompt:4:1110808002.text: Those thugs didn't stand a chance against you!
choice_prompt:4:1110808002.source_cn: 那群流沙之爪对你们完全造不成威胁！

say:5:1110808003:1.text: Did any caravans pass through here on their way to Alkali?
say:5:1110808003:1.source_cn: 之前有没有商队经过这里，往咸水镇去？

say:6:1110808004:1.text: Yes, just a while ago! They were clinging to those metal coins like barnacles to a ship!
say:6:1110808004:1.source_cn: 就在不久前！他们对金属小硬币的执着，比俺这牛脾气还倔！

say:7:1110808005:1.text: No matter how hard I tried to reason with them, they wouldn't budge. They were dead set on doing business in Alkali!
say:7:1110808005:1.source_cn: 不管俺怎么劝，他们都不听，非要去咸水镇做生意！

say:8:1110808006:1.text: Looks like the guy earlier was telling the truth. We should be able to catch up soon.
say:8:1110808006:1.source_cn: 嗯。之前那个商队的人没说谎。应该很快就能追上。

say:10:1110808008:1.text: I trust you guys can handle yourselves! I'll remove the barricade right away.
say:10:1110808008:1.source_cn: 你们，实力可以！俺这就把拒马收起来。

say:11:1110808009:1.text: Though those Quicksand Claws ain't that strong, they're sneaky and there's a bunch of 'em. Like that attack just now, you never know when they'll strike again.
say:11:1110808009:1.source_cn: 那些流沙之爪虽然实力不强，但人多势众，神出鬼没，像刚才...

say:12:1110808010:1.text: Watch your backs on the road!

choice:4:0:1.text: Can you let us in now?
choice:4:0:1.male: Can you let us in now?
choice:4:0:1.female: Can you let us in now?

choice:4:1:2.text: Get the roadblock out of my way!
choice:4:1:2.male: Get the roadblock out of my way!
choice:4:1:2.female: Get the roadblock out of my way!

say:0:1110809001:0.text: Soren, you've been wearing a frown the whole trip. What's on your mind?
say:0:1110809001:0.source_cn: 索恩，你一路上都板着脸，在想什么呢？

say:1:1110809002:0.text: Those kids didn't need to go on some far-fetched treasure hunt to help the Uru Clan grow.
say:1:1110809002:0.source_cn: 乌尔氏族的振兴，根本不需要远方虚无缥缈的宝藏。

say:3:1110809004:0.text: If Alsa were here, she'd probably criticize me for being too harsh...
say:3:1110809004:0.source_cn: ……阿尔萨在的话，会说我太冷漠。

say:4:1110809005:0.text: Hmmm... Or she might say this is your unique way of showing concern for others!
say:4:1110809005:0.source_cn: 嗯……说不定！但阿尔萨更可能说，这就是你关心别人的方式！

say:0:1110810001:0.text: Look! Are these wheel tracks on the ground?
say:0:1110810001:0.source_cn: 看！地上这是车辙的痕迹吗？

say:1:1110810002:0.text: Looks like we're heading in the right direction. Let's keep going.
say:1:1110810002:0.source_cn: 看来方向是对的。继续走。

say:0:1110811001:0.text: Look, there's a camp up ahead! Maybe that's where the caravan is resting?
say:0:1110811001:0.source_cn: 你们看，前面有营地！说不定商队之前有在那里歇脚？

say:2:1110812001:0.text: It's a sizable camp with many caravans, but there aren't many people around...
say:2:1110812001:0.source_cn: 营地很大，有运货马车，但人很少……

choice_prompt:3:1110812001.text: It's a sizable camp with many caravans, but there aren't many people around...
choice_prompt:3:1110812001.source_cn: 营地很大，有运货马车，但人很少……

say:4:1110812002:0.text: But I don't see any Maulers from the Uru Clan around, there should be quite a few of them.
say:4:1110812002:0.source_cn: 但是我没看乌尔氏族的小蛮血呀，按说应该人数不少才对。

say:10:1110812006:0.text: S-Soren!!! You finally came for us!!! *Sob*
say:10:1110812006:0.source_cn: 索、索恩哥哥！你终于来找我们了！！！呜、呜呜呜！

say:14:1110812009:0.text: I'm not as good at comforting people as Alsa...

say:16:1110812011:1.text: It's ok, Soren... I... I will stay strong...
say:16:1110812011:1.source_cn: 没关系，索恩哥哥，瑟巴不哭……瑟巴会坚强……

say:17:1110812012:1.text: Are you here to save everyone? If you beat up all the bad guys, then the people who disappeared will come back, right?
say:17:1110812012:1.source_cn: 你是来救大家的吗？你去把坏人全打倒，被抓走的人是不是就...

choice_prompt:18:1110812012.text: Are you here to save everyone? If you beat up all the bad guys, then the people who disappeared will come back, right?
choice_prompt:18:1110812012.source_cn: 你是来救大家的吗？你去把坏人全打倒，被抓走的人是不是就能回来了！

say:19:1110812013:0.text: Umm... I heard it from those people who sell things, they called them... Quickhand Paws?
say:19:1110812013:0.source_cn: 嗯……我是听卖东西的那些叔叔姐姐们说的，好像是叫……流...

choice_prompt:20:1110812013.text: Umm... I heard it from those people who sell things, they called them... Quickhand Paws?
choice_prompt:20:1110812013.source_cn: 嗯……我是听卖东西的那些叔叔姐姐们说的，好像是叫……流沙之牙！

say:21:1110812014:0.text: Oh, yes! The Quicksand Claws! They rode these really big birds as tall as three grown-ups! They just showed up on the road! It was so scary, I hid under the carriage and didn't dare to move...
say:21:1110812014:0.source_cn: 啊，对！是流沙之爪！他们骑着三个人那么高的大鸟，突然出...

say:22:1110812015:1.text: When I finally peeked out, Kaleb, Jerry, and Carley were all gone! The merchants said the Quickhand Paws took them...
say:22:1110812015:1.source_cn: 等出来一看，库布、扎拉和卡阿他们，都不见了！卖东西的那...

say:24:1110812017:1.text: Those merchants probably witnessed everything. Let's go and ask them for details.
say:24:1110812017:1.source_cn: 那些商人目击了劫人的过程……问问他们。

choice:13:0:1.text: You sure know how to comfort others...
choice:13:0:1.male: You sure know how to comfort others...
choice:13:0:1.female: You sure know how to comfort others...

choice:3:0:1.text: This must be where they stopped.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 看来这里就是商队停靠点
choice:3:0:1.male: This must be where they stopped.
choice:3:0:1.female: This must be where they stopped.

say:2:1110813001:0.text: We've lost almost seventy percent of the cargo, all the laborers, and those young Maulers who came with the caravans are also gone!
say:2:1110813001:0.source_cn: 货物损失了七成，力工一个也没剩下，还有那些跟队来的蛮血...

say:3:1110813002:1.text: How am I supposed to explain this to the Mauler clans on the other side of the desert?! We're not just dealing with financial loss here. People are missing!
say:3:1110813002:1.source_cn: 金钱损失也就算了，人丢了，我怎么向沙漠那边的蛮血氏族交代？！

say:4:1110813003:0.text: We're going to rescue everyone—our kin from the <style="highlight">Thundra Clan</style>, the young Maulers of the Uru Clan, and your laborers.

say:5:1110813004:1.text: Giving up now means forsaking all our honor!
say:5:1110813004:1.source_cn: 现在放弃，没有荣耀可言！

say:6:1110813005:1.text: <style="highlight">All the young and strong ones have been taken by the Quicksand Claws!</style> Who's left to rescue them now?!

say:11:1110813007:1.text: Young Mauler, the scent on you tells the tale of another clan.
say:11:1110813007:1.source_cn: 年轻的蛮血，你身上的气味讲述着另一个氏族的故事。

say:12:1110813008:0.text: I'm from the Uru Clan. My kin have been taken by the Quicksand Claws.
say:12:1110813008:0.source_cn: 乌尔氏族。我的族人被流沙之爪带走了。

say:13:1110813009:0.text: So, the future leader those Mauler kids talked about is you?
say:13:1110813009:0.source_cn: 你，那些蛮血孩子说的未来领袖就是你？

say:14:1110813010:0.text: But you... you're just a kid yourself. We're discussing plans to rescue them. The Quicksand Claws operate stealthily and they outnumber us. We can't act recklessly right now.

say:0:1110829001:0.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒，咸水镇在哪个方向？

say:1:1110829002:0.text: We have to go east from here, through a canyon and over a wooden bridge.
say:1:1110829002:0.source_cn: 从这里一路往东，经过一座峡谷和木桥才能到。
say:1:1110829002:0.male: We have to go east from here, through a canyon and over a wooden bridge.
say:1:1110829002:0.female: We have to go east from here, through a canyon and over a wooden bridge.

say:2:1110829003:0.text: Be careful not to get blown away by the sandstorms! *Laughs*
say:2:1110829003:0.source_cn: 小心别被风沙吹走哦，哈哈！
say:2:1110829003:0.male: Be careful not to get blown away by the sandstorms! *Laughs*
say:2:1110829003:0.female: Be careful not to get blown away by the sandstorms! *Laughs*

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110807001:.text: Looks like we got some new laborers!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110807003:.text: Be careful! These are the Quicksand Claws I mentioned before!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1110807003:.source_cn: 小心，他们就是流沙之爪！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110807004:.text: They just seem like a bunch of riffraff.
